title: Love it
text:
Love it. I chose this because I didn't want to run up the electric bill & because I can use it just about anywhere I need to without having to worry about finding an outlet to plug it in.

I actually received it about 3 days before the actual delivery date which was great cause I really needed it asap. There are only 3 things I don't like about it. 1) It burns through 1lb tanks like crazy even on low settings but I only run it about 15 min +\- 2) After it heats up the on/off knob sometimes sticks. 3) i'm stuck with a ton of empty 1lb tanks and don't know where to get rid of them. I don't want to just throw them in the trash. (the only reasons I gave it 4 stars instead of 5) so its can be hard to shut off when I want. Other then that, I love the thing. It does a great job heating up my little 10'x 12' room quite quick and nice in those few minutes I do run it. I would love to buy a 20lb tank and the valve set & hose needed and such to be able to refill all the 1lb tanks that are collecting from using it. I have about 10 empty 1lb tanks that I've used up within about 1 or so weeks.

This is an Edit of this review. For some reason after using this thing for about alittle over a month or so, after turning it on for about 15 minutes the on/off knob locks up and I CAN NOT turn the unit off at all unless I trip the tip over circuit on it. Once it cools down the know starts working normal again. After paying $81.16 for this you would think you could run it none stop for days and not have the on/off knob lock. I don't know why it does it. and wish it didn't for the money I paid for it. I don't even know who to contact about this or what needs done to either fix it or replace it without costing more money I don't have to get the thing working like an $81.16 heater should. Other then this HUGE PROBLEM I do still love having this thing cause it gets very cold in my room even with the heat in the house turned up to 75 degrees. Don'g know why my room is the coldest room in the house but it is or I wouldn't have had to waste $81.16 on a portable heater to keep me warm when needed.

I would recommend this to anyone who asks me for advice about what kind of heater they should buy if they needed 1.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Heater F232000 MH9BX Buddy 4,000-9,000-BTU Indoor-Safe Portable Propane Radiant Heater, Red-Black
features: PORTABLE HEATER: Portable propane heater designed for emergency heat, tents, campers, job sites, porches, decks, garages, tailgates, barns, sheds, ice fishing, hunting blinds, and more
HEAT SPACE: Perfect for heating enclosed spaces up to 225 square feet
PROPANE GAS: For use with propane gas; Runs off a 1-pound cylinder of propane and can connect directly to a 20 pound cylinder with optional hose and filter
FEATURES: Includes Piezo igniter, Accidental tip-over safety shut-off, swivel regulator and fold-down handle, and hi and low heat settings

SPECIFICATIONS: 4,000 or 9,000 BTU per hour; Run time (max BTU): 3 hours; Run time (min BTU): 6 hours; Heating technology type: Radiant; Power type: Propane; Indoor safe: Yes; Fuel consumption/burn rate (Gal/Hr): 4,000 BTU = 0.044 gal/hr, at 9,000 BTU = 0.099 gal/hr; Dimensions (L x W x H): 14.25 x 9 x 15 inches; Weight: 10.6 pounds
description: North America's Most Popular Portable Propane Heater! This patented radiant 4,000-9,000 BTU Liquid Propane heater connects directly to a 1 lb. cylinder and is the perfect solution for heating enclosed spaces like large tents up to 200 sq. ft. The expertly engineered size to BTU ratio is augmented with a fold down handle to give this heater maximum output while retaining a minimalistic footprint. A swivel regulator gives you the ability to adapt usage from a disposable cylinder to a remote gas supply with the purchase of a hose and filter. To light the unit, simply rotate the knob to pilot and push. Then the integrated Piezo sparking mechanism will take care of the rest. With the Oxygen Depletion Sensor (ODS) and accidental tip-over safety shut-off you can be sure that you will enjoy years of comfortable indoor safe heat.*WE ARE NOT ABLE TO SELL THIS PRODUCT TO CANADA AND MASSACHUSETTS* **Please note when operating the heater at altitudes over 7,000 FT above sea level the heater may shut off. Use- Emergency Heat, Tents, Campers, Workshops, Job Sites, Porches, Patios, Decks, Garages, Storage Buildings, Picnics, Tailgate Parties, Construction Trailers, Sporting Events, Barns, Sheds, Hunting Blinds, Shelters, Ice Fishing Shanties.The product voltage arrange is 110V.
